subject: Computer Science

internalBreakdown.component: Lab test: SQL queries (4 queries on one or two tables)
Report file (15 Python programs, 5 SQL sets, 4 Python-SQL programs)

textbooks: Support material on the CBSE website
notes: The document states learning outcomes for the whole course, recorded on the first chapter of each unit.
Project: groups of two to three, using Python file handling or Python-SQL connectivity to solve a real problem.

chapters.name: Revision of Python
topics: Revision of Python topics covered in Class XI

chapters.name: Functions
topics: Built-in, module-defined and user defined functions
Arguments and parameters: default and positional; returning values
Flow of execution; global and local scope

chapters.name: Exception Handling
topics: Handling exceptions using try-except-finally

chapters.name: File Handling
topics: Text, binary and CSV files; relative and absolute paths
Text files: open modes r, r+, w, w+, a, a+; with clause; write, writelines, read, readline, readlines; seek and tell
Binary files: modes rb to ab+; pickle dump and load; read, write, search, append, update
CSV files: csv module, writer, writerow, writerows, reader
outcomes: Explain and use the concept of file handling

chapters.name: Data Structure: Stack
topics: Stack operations push and pop
Implementation of a stack using a list

chapters.name: Computer Networks
topics: Evolution: ARPANET, NSFNET, Internet
Data communication: components, bandwidth, data transfer rate, IP address, circuit and packet switching
Transmission media: twisted pair, co-axial, fibre-optic; radio waves, microwaves, infrared
Devices: modem, Ethernet card, RJ45, repeater, hub, switch, router, gateway, Wi-Fi card
Network types (PAN, LAN, MAN, WAN) and topologies (bus, star, tree)
Protocols: HTTP, FTP, PPP, SMTP, TCP/IP, POP3, HTTPS, TELNET, VoIP
Web services: WWW, HTML, XML, domain names, URL, website, browser, web servers, web hosting
outcomes: Explain the basics of computer networks

chapters.name: Database Concepts and the Relational Model
topics: Need for databases
Relation, attribute, tuple, domain, degree, cardinality
Keys: candidate, primary, alternate, foreign

chapters.name: Structured Query Language
topics: DDL and DML; data types char, varchar, int, float, date; constraints not null, unique, primary key
create, use, show and drop database; show, create, describe, alter and drop table
insert, delete, select, update; operators, aliasing, distinct, where, in, between, order by, null, like
Aggregate functions max, min, avg, sum, count; group by, having
Joins: cartesian product, equi-join, natural join

chapters.name: Interface of Python with an SQL Database
topics: Connecting SQL with Python
insert, update, delete via cursor; connect, cursor, execute, commit, fetchone, fetchall, rowcount
%s format specifier or format() in queries
